name: Over The Hills And Far Away
source: The War of 1812. Northwest Frontier. William Aubrey, a rogue redcoat of the once-glorious 41st Regiment of Foot, is on the run. Wounded and tired, he seeks shelter during a thunderstorm inside an abandoned barn. But when he gets there, he finds he’s not alone. A young Shawnee girl, named Mai, is hiding from the rain too. Bleeding out and not wanting to brave the fierce winds outside, Aubrey decides to put up with her until the rains let up. But will their accord outlast the storm; when both return to the bloodshed and the outside world?
translation: 1812年战争，西北边疆。威廉·奥布里是曾经辉煌的第41步兵团中的叛逆英军士兵，如今正在逃亡。他身负重伤、疲惫不堪，雷雨中躲进一座废弃谷仓。可到那里后，他发现自己并不孤单：一名名叫舞的肖尼族少女也在躲雨。伤口不断流血，又不想冒着外面凶猛的风暴前进，奥布里决定暂时忍受与她共处，直到雨停。然而，当两人重新回到血腥战场与外面的世界时，他们之间的约定能撑过这场风暴吗？
